summary: Frietboutique is a small Dutch fresh-fries business that runs four shops in Rotterdam, Amsterdam and Laren and supplies fresh fries to restaurants. It washes, hand-cuts and pre-fries Dutch Agria potatoes every day. It was founded in 2013 by Sammy Berendsen and Pebbles van Noorden.
products: Fresh fries made from Dutch Agria potatoes
Snacks with meat, vegetarian and vegan options
Milkshakes, iced coffee, coffee and soft drinks
Event catering with a food truck and an ice cart
markets: Online ordering for pickup at each shop
facts: Founded in 2013; marked its 10th anniversary in 2023
Four shops: two in Rotterdam, one in Amsterdam, one in Laren
Uses the Agria potato variety, grown in the Netherlands
limitations: The website does not publish a legal entity name, ownership structure, or a production site separate from the shops.
Capacity, potato volumes, turnover, growers, export markets and certifications are not published on the pages read.
